observations.information_root: Finnish Defence Forces eastern Gulf precautionary restrictions 2026-11-11
observations.summary: Reuters reports Finnish defence forces announced precautionary partial airspace and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland amid regional drone threats. The restrictions are a protective measure, not evidence of an attack or blockade. Original announcement time and exact restriction geometry were not independently verified.
observations.title: Finland adopts temporary eastern Gulf of Finland airspace and maritime restrictions

observations.information_root: Leningrad governor Drozdenko Ust-Luga drone attack statement 2026-11-11
observations.summary: Leningrad region governor reported a drone attack causing a fire in Ust-Luga port area, three workers injured and power station outage. Reuters could not independently verify; no verified export throughput loss or perpetrator attribution. Reported during regional cross-border drone warnings.
observations.title: Russian governor reports Ust-Luga port fire and electricity disruption after drone attack
